chosen_because: GT-E1 reflection section 6 (handover mechanism recommended) and GT-P005; coverage audit gravity-time/docs/e2-coverage-audit.md

clocks.continuous: pi_ct = pi_jump / R; currents and circulations per unit time
clocks.jump: pi_jump; event-order, partner frame, matched-dissolution weights and passage horizons in jump events

comparisons.C1_sigma_versus_orientation: for every irreversible cell, the sign of sigma against the sign of the partner-frame index and (HELD) the handover index; no expectation beyond the local identity
comparisons.C2_circulation_alignment: share of adjacent-square circulation (|C| mass) aligned with, counter to, or on squares without local affinity
comparisons.C3_matched_dissolution: per relation class and action, the mechanism list (strict enabling/disabling, rate facilitation/suppression, normalisation-dominated, passage raised/lowered at H=8) and the precedence ratio beside the intervention effects
comparisons.C4_frames: partner-frame index against class-free and hub-frame event-order asymmetry, HELD and FREE
comparisons.C5_n5_n6: HELD attachment/probe squares with negative far-endpoint degree difference (impossible at N=5 by I5) and their circulation share at N=6
comparisons.C6_grade_ladder: PATHF and PATHH across prohibit, strong_suppress, weak_suppress, weak_favour, strong_favour: flux, density, partner index, handover index
comparisons.C7_hard_support: EXCL, EXPH, EXPF and the two prohibit path cells: closed-class structure, one-way transitions, strict-enabling shares, and whether strict enabling coexists with circulation
comparisons.no_aggregate_score: no handover-strength or relevance score is formed; cells are not ranked

controls_and_identities.I1_square_formula: on every intact square of every cell, |A - sigma*(deg_x(r) - deg_x(q))| <= 1e-12 (theorem, docs/e2-formal-mechanism.md; checked pre-freeze on synthetic factor tables at N=4, 5)
controls_and_identities.I2_disjoint_squares: every intact square on disjoint slots has |A| <= 1e-12 (corollary)
controls_and_identities.I3_sigma_zero: cells with sigma = 0 (NULL, CLOSEW, EXCL, PFD ws+ws, PFD wf+wf): irreversible flux, |partner index|, hub-frame asymmetry and (HELD) |handover index| <= 1e-9 (corollary of I1 plus Kolmogorov, where the class has no one-way transitions)
controls_and_identities.I4_rate_symmetric: NULL, PFD ws+ws, PFD wf+wf: form and dissolve factors are equal on every pair, so pi is uniform on the class (class-level L1 <= 1e-9)
controls_and_identities.I5_held_n5: at HELD N=5 no attachment/probe square has a negative far-endpoint degree difference (a source vertex has the two other source vertices; a probe has at most two other neighbours besides the pair), so every such square has the sign of sigma
controls_and_identities.Z5_numerical: stationary two-start agreement, residual, symmetry, autocorrelation cap, kernel sample (rule strings), affinity reference (rule strings, exact Fractions), long-double residual, GTH referee, partner-frame loop reference and passage path-enumeration reference; tolerances as E1 (gte1) and 1e-12 for the new references
controls_and_identities.separation_note: I1-I5 are identities; none predicts the sign or size of a stationary current, an event-order index, a matched-dissolution effect or a passage probability

deliberate_omissions.fine_grade_tuning: grades are the W4 alphabet as listed; no interpolation
deliberate_omissions.new_primitives: none; 'prohibit' and adj_form are existing grammar

estimands: every gtobs channel, the square census, partner frame, matched dissolution and one-way structure of each cell, and C1-C7
initial_conditions: as E0: HELD starts at the source triangle, FREE at the empty graph; the reachable class from the start is analysed; if it is not recurrent and has exactly one closed class of more than one state, that class is analysed and the restriction is recorded; otherwise the cell is reported by its class structure only
matched_dissolution_definition: for every non-source slot g and every state x with g present whose partner x- = x without g is in the class: conditioning weight pi_jump(x) normalised over those x (an intervention instrument that removes g from a stationary state; not a claim that the model contains interventions). For every other slot f and action (form if f absent in x, else dissolve): strict enabling share (W(x,f)=0, W(x-,f)>0), strict disabling share, mean log rate ratio log W(x-,f)/W(x,f) where both positive, mean log jump-probability ratio and its normalisation part (jump minus rate), passage delta u_H(x-,f) - u_H(x,f) for H in {1,2,4,8} jump events with u_H the probability that f toggles at least once within H events, and the precedence ratio p(next event toggles f | dissolve g just executed) / p(an event toggles f). Grouped by slot class of g and f, adjacency and the shared vertex type
numerical_policy: gtobs stationary (two starts, relative stop), GTH referee on every cell (every class has at most 4,096 states), long-double per-entry residual, kernel sample check (rule strings, exact Fractions, 400 states), affinity reference (120 seeded intact squares from rule strings), partner-frame loop reference, passage path-enumeration reference (12 seeded (state, slot) pairs, H = 1, 2, 3); children single-threaded

observables.round: square census, partner frame, handover index (HELD), matched dissolution, one-way transitions, frozen exemplars (largest |circulation|, largest |affinity|, largest |circulation| against its affinity)

open_questions_without_prediction: Does the sign of every irreversible cell's partner-frame index (and HELD handover index) follow the sign of sigma, or do aggregated statistics cancel or reverse it anywhere?
How much stationary circulation sits on squares with no local affinity, and how much runs against local affinity?
When sigma < 0, is there a reversed stationary current of comparable size, or does saturation hide it (S1, S5)?
Which cells show strict enabling by dissolution, and does strict enabling coexist with circulation or only with reversible dynamics?
Does the observed precedence after a dissolution agree with the intervention effect, or is it a selection effect?
Does the partner frame make FREE circulation legible where the class-free frame does not, and how does it compare with the hub frame?
At HELD N=6, how much circulation sits on reversed attachment/probe squares?

pre_freeze_exposure.engineering: plumbing tests and a smoke run use synthetic N=4 cells (all 21 family-grades, HELD and FREE; N=4 is not a round size) and synthetic factor tables. The smoke run was read: among other things it showed one-way irreversibility without square affinity in FREE N=4 path_form prohibit (flux 0.12) and an arrested single state in HELD N=4 path_form prohibit. Timing used the published HELD N=6 CLOSEW cell (not a round cell; only costs read)
pre_freeze_exposure.formula_fixtures: the square formula was checked before freezing on synthetic factor tables (non-alphabet factors 0.13, 0.41, 2.7, 6.3 and 0) at N=4 and N=5, HELD and FREE, for four synthetic mixes; no round cell kernel or law was used
pre_freeze_exposure.note: the cells listed have published standard gtobs/E0 channels; their square census, partner frame, matched-dissolution and one-way channels have never been computed. No other round cell was computed before freezing

question: What makes relational changes occur in directionally ordered sequences, and when does dissolving a relation enable a later change rather than merely precede it?
sampling: exact census of 46 declared cells: five strata at N=5 in HELD and FREE, plus four HELD N=6 robustness cells
selection_rule: strata chosen from the coverage audit: (S1) every W4 grade of each single path component; (S2) all four form/dissolve weak-grade pairs, which give sigma = -2 log 2, 0, 0, +2 log 2; (S3) the reversible gradient control, the null and the hard closure exclusion (strict support without path terms); (S4) hard closure exclusion plus each unsaturated path component; (S5) the strong adjacency suppression opposed to each weak path-form grade (one sigma<0, one sigma>0 comparator), fixed before results; (S6) HELD N=6 for the two published weak path cells and the two strong grades with sigma>0. Excluded: other closure/adjacency grades, three-component mixes, N=7, FREE N=6

stop_conditions.amendment: any change of cells or estimands after freeze stops the round for explicit amendment
stop_conditions.item: watchdog {5: 900, 6: 900} seconds by N; a killed cell is recorded unresolved
stop_conditions.round: all items or the 7200-second wall cap; then stop

tolerances.e1_numerical: gte1 constants (referee 1e-10 L1 and 1e-8 relative; residual 1e-9; kernel 1e-12)

work_count.estimate_note: measured before freezing: synthetic N=4 cells 0.04-0.08 s; published HELD N=6 CLOSEW (not a round cell) 48 s at 312 MB, of which 47 s are the GTH referee and loop references. Round estimate: 42 N=5 cells at seconds each plus 4 N=6 cells at about 1 minute: under 10 minutes on 4 workers
